crossRefs.note: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

translations.web: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD.
translations.kjv: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
translations.asv: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah.
